Hi Leah — thanks for the details and the sheet, that helps. Two practical ways we can handle this without a long procurement cycle:

Option A — Credit bucket (fastest):
- 200k token credit bucket applied to the pilot account, expires in 45 days.
- No change to SLA.
- Ops fee: none for credit buckets under $X (we waive the one-time burst ops fee for this case).

Option B — Short extension (14 days):
- Extend pilot by 14 calendar days with the same per-token rate.
- One-time operational surcharge of $1,500 to cover burst scheduling and priority routing.
- If you convert to a Dedicated commitment within 30 days after the extension, we will credit the $1,500 back against the first invoice.

I attached a quick draft of the pilot terms that reflects both options (redwood-pilot-terms-draft.pdf) — Option A can be issued as a simple credit memo and requires minimal paperwork; Option B needs a short amendment but still a light touch.

Internal note: looping in Laura to confirm finance ok with waiving the ops fee under Option A and to sign off on the credit memo flow.

Are either of these workable from your side? If you prefer, we can provision the credit immediately and follow up with paperwork next week.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
